name: Amamiya Sena
source:
Ashe's classmate, a boy with golden-colored hair and eyes. From the first day they met, he spoke to her in a kind and friendly way. He has a light-hearted disposition and is nice to everyone without discriminating, but he has a soft spot for girls especially.

Leni scolds him for hanging around Ashe so much, but Sena doesn't pay it any mind.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=289405]Getchu[/url]]
